slots.jd.residential-electric.about:
About us and the job
Marlow Residential Electric is an owner-run electrical contractor working in homes in and around Spokane. We wire new houses, update older ones and fix what has gone wrong. We are looking for a journeyman electrician to join our crew. The work is on site, in customers' homes, and you will often run a job on your own. We care about doing the work right and treating our people and customers fairly.
slots.jd.residential-electric.duties:
What the job involves
- Read plans and drawings to lay out each job before you start
- Pull and terminate wire in new builds and existing homes
- Install and upgrade panels, breakers and service equipment
- Mount and connect light fixtures, outlets, switches and fans
- Test your work and leave each site clean and ready for inspection
- Talk with homeowners about what you are doing and why
slots.jd.residential-electric.needs:
What you need
- 5 or more years of experience as an electrician, mostly in residential work
- A current Journeyman Electrician Licence is required; a Master Electrician Licence is preferred
- Solid skills in grounding and bonding, circuit testing and code compliance
- Blueprint reading and load calculations for residential services and circuits
- Troubleshooting skills to find and fix faults in existing wiring
slots.r1.b1: Pulls and terminates wire through framed walls and finished spaces, applying careful power tool use to cut rough-in time by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Routes and secures conduit with close attention to code compliance, checking each run against local rules before inspection.
slots.r1.b3: Installs panels and fixtures and verifies every connection through multimeter use, reducing callbacks by 45 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Traces faults in existing wiring with methodical circuit testing, isolating the cause before replacing any parts.
slots.r1.i1: Installs panels and fixtures for Redfern Electrical Services, completing each job independently and to code.
slots.r1.i2: Traces and repairs electrical faults for Redfern Electrical Services, from dead circuits to loose connections.
slots.r2.b1: Read plans to lay out grounding and bonding paths before rough-in, cutting inspection rework by 30 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Tested circuits after panel installation to confirm correct breaker sizing and labelling before handover.
slots.r2.b3: Pulled and terminated wire guided by blueprint reading of each floor plan, reducing material waste by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Ran conduit across job sites, using conduit bending to form offsets and saddles around obstacles.

slots.summary.1: Journeyman electrician with about 5 years of experience completing electrical work to code without supervision. Brings code compliance, multimeter use and blueprint reading to wiring, panel and fixture jobs.
slots.summary.2: Licensed journeyman electrician with about 5 years in the trade, taking jobs from plans to final inspection independently. Strengths include blueprint reading, multimeter use and code compliance on every installation.
